name: vacancies-bot
description: Telegram bot for posting dev vacancies from BY, RU, GE, AM, KZ

scripts.store:clear: ts-node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {PublishedStore} = require('./src/store'); const s = new PublishedStore(); s.init().then(() => s.clear()).then(() => { console.log('Store cleared.'); process.exit(0); })"
scripts.store:show: ts-node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {PublishedStore} = require('./src/store'); const s = new PublishedStore(); s.init().then(() => s.size).then(n => { console.log('Records:', n); process.exit(0); })"
